target.description: Conditional radial gas temperature field for established fast-chemistry burning with supplied thermochemistry and apparatus properties.

features.name: stream_compositions
features.source: fuel/oxidizer/products GasMixture elemental inventories and fractions

features.name: species_heat_capacities
features.source: supplied species constant cp over explicit temperature path

features.name: formation_enthalpies
features.source: three supplied mixture formation enthalpies in common reference

features.name: gravity
features.source: supplied gravity vector/frame/provenance; exactly zero admitted

features.name: ambient_velocity
features.source: supplied ambient vector/frame/provenance; zero crossflow admitted

features.name: initial_fuel_origin_fraction
features.source: RadialInitialState with provenance and time origin

tensors.name: solid_angle_sr
tensors.description: 4*pi manually written; exact sphere geometry required by forward.

tensors.name: lewis_number
tensors.description: Unity Lewis closure; forward rejects any value other than one.

tensors.name: stefan_boltzmann_w_m2_k4
tensors.description: NIST CODATA 2022 displayed decimal value, manually transcribed; decimal truncation is numerical, not physical uncertainty.

notes: Normal fuel injection. Internal kernel only; no cross-lane contract or live forecast adapter added. Read tensors in order solid_angle_sr, lewis_number, stefan_boltzmann_w_m2_k4 into Parameters::from_literals. forward supplies independent analytic steady benchmark; evolve_radial advances prescribed initial fields. Numerical controls are explicit non-predictive inputs. Bounds with zero endpoints do not supersede strict positivity in kernel. Properties require admitted sources and valid domains. No trained parent; experimental/not_trained only. Static fields, geometry SI vectors and component metadata are preserved; SI-only inputs have identical raw and SI units. No uncertainty interval or NASA qualification.
